opening.argument: The video presents buying Polybius tokens as an investment: its title reads “POLYBIUS BANK / How to buy its tokens,” while the speaker directs viewers, “To invest, you come here You fill in your data.” It promotes an additional return, stating, “You get bonus of 25 percent after each day,” and instructs viewers that “your wallet will send your Bitcoins to this wallet.” The displayed confirmation panel reinforces a payment-for-token offer by showing 1.00000000 BTC requested, a wallet destination, an expiration timer, and PLBT to be received. These elements establish a token-purchase solicitation involving appreciation or bonuses, although they do not establish that any transfer or delivery occurred or verify the claims.
